title: Troll
script:
-- Random money
getgenv().moneyrandom = not getgenv().moneyrandom
if getgenv().moneyrandom then
	repeat
		local randommoney = math.random(1, 999999)
		print(randommoney)
		game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").CratesUtilities.Remotes.GiveReward:FireServer(randommoney-game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.leaderstats.Money.Value)
		task.wait(0.1)
	until not getgenv().moneyrandom
end

-- Clear all money
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").CratesUtilities.Remotes.RemoveMoney:FireServer(game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.leaderstats.Money.Value)

-- Give money (HERE IS NO GOING BACK IF YOU USE MATH.HUGE)
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").CratesUtilities.Remotes.GiveReward:FireServer(10)

-- Give 10,000
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").GiveClaimMoney:FireServer()

-- Give 1K
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").GlassMoney.Give_1k:FireServer()\

-- Give 1
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").GiveCoins:FireServer()

-- Show all paths
game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.ShowPath.Value = false

-- Carpet 100% from creat
for _,v in pairs(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").CratesUtilities.Itens.Basic:GetChildren()) do
    if v.Name == "Carpet" then
        v:SetAttribute("porcentage", 100)
    else
        v:SetAttribute("porcentage", 0)
    end
end
for _,v in pairs(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").CratesUtilities.Itens.Lucky:GetChildren()) do
    if v.Name == "Carpet" then
        v:SetAttribute("porcentage", 100)
    else
        v:SetAttribute("porcentage", 0)
    end
end
for _,v in pairs(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").CratesUtilities.Itens.Robux:GetChildren()) do
    if v.Name == "Carpet" then
        v:SetAttribute("porcentage", 100)
    else
        v:SetAttribute("porcentage", 0)
    end
end
